scientific_question: Can a small set of horizon-specific probabilistic forecasters be improved by soft state-dependent competence weighting, while preserving legacy Gold Control engines as context rather than flat direction votes?

targets.NEXT_NY17_1D: sign of log return from governed NY17 origin to next governed NY17 observation
targets.NEXT_NY17_3D: sign of log return from governed NY17 origin to third subsequent governed NY17 observation

origin: exact governed XAU/USD NY17 observation; no random split
maturity_rule: expert/meta learning at origin t may use forecast j only when j+h<=t
legacy_engine_role_rule: Legacy engines are frozen information channels. FAST/SLOW/MONTHLY_DIRECTION are trend-state context; Emergency is stress/reversal context. They are not equal votes and are not retuned in V1.62.

meta_methods.BEST_SINGLE_PRIOR: select expert with lowest matured cumulative Brier loss; minimum 60 matured forecasts
meta_methods.EQUAL_MEAN: equal mean of available expert probabilities

RECENT_EXP.description: exponential expert weighting by matured Brier loss

LOCAL_SOFT.description: RBF state-local matured Brier competence with recency weighting
LOCAL_SOFT.bandwidth: median positive prior-only distance from current state; fallback 1.0

CRASE_V0.description: LOCAL_SOFT plus predicted-class degeneracy penalty and selective abstention

evaluation.three_day_dependence: overlap acknowledged; no IID significance claim; block/HAC inference required before promotion

interpretation_rule: This run is a method-development diagnostic. A positive result is a lead, not prospective proof or production authority. No V1.62 threshold, feature, expert or horizon may be changed after seeing V1.62 scores; any change requires V1.63/new frozen hypothesis.
